gbm_population_evidence.quote: Bevacizumab Neoadjuvant Therapy for New High-grade Gliomas in the Brain

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients were enrolled and given bevacizumab on days 1 and 15, administered by intravenous infusion at 5 mg/kg.
The aim of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of bevacizumab in the preoperative adjuvant treatment of patients with new-onset high-grade gliomas.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The aim of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of bevacizumab in the preoperative adjuvant treatment of patients with new-onset high-grade gliomas.

role_evidence.quote: The aim of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of bevacizumab in the preoperative adjuvant treatment of patients with new-onset high-grade gliomas.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: binds VEGF-A and blocks VEGFR-mediated signalling, inhibiting tumour angiogenesis

coder_notes: Population is 'high-grade glioma' by imaging; glioblastoma is named only in the brief summary and detailed description, which do not count (C7), so high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Bevacizumab is an established GBM therapy (D6) tested in a new neoadjuvant/preoperative setting: established_therapy_experiment, so no eligible candidate. Phase NA.
